parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain why the gravitational potential near to a point mass is negative.

parts.label: (b)
(b)(i)
parts.text: Show that the mass of the planet is $8.8 \times 10^{25} \text{kg}$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
The period of rotation of the planet is 0.72 Earth days.

A satellite in orbit around the planet remains above the same point on the surface of the planet.

Use the mass of the planet in (b)(i) to determine the radius $R$ of the orbit of the satellite.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:
The speed of the satellite in (b)(ii) is $8400 \text{m s}^{-1}$. The mass of the satellite is $1200 \text{kg}$.

Determine the additional energy required to move the satellite from its orbit to infinity.
